title: tcia-shortcut-audit: screening public cancer CT benchmarks for acquisition shortcuts
description:
Open screening tool, full analysis code, results with run records and frozen foundation-model embeddings for the study Screening public cancer CT benchmarks for non-tumour shortcuts: tissue-free prediction and the limits of external validation.

The tool (tool/tcia_shortcut_audit.py, version 1.0.1) checks, before any image is downloaded, whether the labels of a classification task built on The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) can be predicted from acquisition metadata alone. The repository also holds the dated analysis plans, notebooks 01-13 with their executed copies, every result folder with its run_manifest.json, and the post hoc checks R1-R24. No images are included; they remain available from TCIA under each collection's licence.

Code: MIT licence. Derived data (tables, results, embeddings): CC BY 4.0.
